title: Luke Moffat
text:
Hi, I’m Luke — a Computer Science student at BYU-Idaho focused on data science and full-stack development. I like taking messy data and turning it into something clear: cleaned-up datasets, honest charts, and tools people actually use.
This site is my data science portfolio. It collects the work I’m most proud of — data cleansing and exploration, storytelling with data, machine learning, and full-stack projects.

title: Luke Moffat
text:
Where to start

My Resume — education, skills, and projects at a glance
Data Cleansing — wrangling raw, messy data into usable shape
Data Exploration — digging into datasets to find the story
Story Telling — communicating findings with visuals
Machine Learning — models and predictions
Full Stack — end-to-end apps built around data

title: Luke Moffat
text:
Elsewhere
You can also find me at moffatluke.com — my main portfolio site with an AI assistant trained on my background — or on GitHub.

title: Luke Moffat
text:
Currently
Studying Computer Science / Software Engineering at BYU-Idaho, with an emphasis on data science and full-stack development. Recently accepted into Sandbox, BYU-Idaho’s student startup accelerator, starting Fall 2026.

Specialized in
SQL and relational databases, full-stack web development (React, Express, Flask), and growing skill in Python data science tooling (Polars, pandas).


Interests
Data cleansing and analysis, building developer tools, and applied machine learning.

title: Luke Moffat
text:
Education
Expected Winter 2028 BYU-Idaho — Software Engineering / Computer Science
Current coursework: Applied Programming, Data Science Programming (Python/Polars), Programming with Data Structures, SQL, Old Testament

Relevant coursework: CSE 310 (Applied Programming), CSE 212 (Data Structures), DS 250 (Data Science Programming), ITM 220 (SQL)

title: Luke Moffat
text:
Projects
2026 Cloud Database CRM — Flask + Firestore finance/CRM dashboard, deployed with a public read-only demo
2026 Lawn Hunters Admin Panel — Full-stack React + Express admin panel backed by a MySQL database
2026 Obsidian Dev Tracker — Custom Obsidian plugin visualizing GitHub contributions and Claude Code sessions as heatmaps
2026 Startup Idea Validator — Sprint project for validating early-stage startup concepts
See more on GitHub and the projects section of this site.
